name: Kagari
source:
Noah's lord who is over 130 years old.  Kagari leaves Noah to take care of his house and fields while he spends all his time picking up girls in the city. [spoiler]He is actually an alchemist who is familiar with ancient magic, and the creator of Noah, who is a homunculus.[/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%A9%BA%E3%81%AE%E3%81%A4%E3%81%8F%E3%82%8A%E3%81%8B%E3%81%9F]Wikipedia[/url].]
